title: OsianView Hotel Management System
shortDescription: A complete hotel booking web application with a dedicated admin dashboard, user authentication, service browsing, and booking workflows.
fullDescription: I’m excited to share my full-stack project, OsianView Hotel — a complete hotel booking web application with a dedicated admin dashboard. This project includes user authentication, hotel room booking, service browsing, and booking management on the client side, while the admin panel enables adding and editing rooms as well as managing customer bookings. Through this project, I gained hands-on experience in full-stack development, particularly in building a secure backend, integrating it with a dynamic React frontend, implementing authentication, and managing real-world booking workflows. 🧑‍💻

title: Cloud Retail Billing Web Application
shortDescription: A real-world retail billing web application featuring AWS cloud media storage, product & category management, dynamic inventory, and Spring Boot REST APIs.
fullDescription: I’m excited to share my second full-stack test project, a Billing Web Application developed for a real-world retail client. This project features category and product management, image upload and handling using AWS and local file systems, REST APIs built with Spring Boot, and a dynamic user interface developed with React and Bootstrap, including real-time updates along with search and delete functionality. Through this experience, I gained hands-on exposure to AWS, backend API development, and modern frontend practices, while also improving my self-learning skills and deepening my understanding of building scalable, real-world applications and integrating backend systems with cloud-based file handling. 🧑‍💻

title: GSAP Animation Practice
shortDescription: A practice project for learning GSAP animations.
fullDescription: This is a practice project for learning GSAP animations, focusing on creating smooth and engaging animations for web applications.

title: AMITY – Event Management Platform
shortDescription: A platform for university events and student opportunities.
fullDescription: AMITY is a platform designed to facilitate university events and student opportunities. It allows users to browse and register for various events, while providing administrators with tools to manage event listings, registrations, and user interactions. This project showcases my ability to build a full-stack application with a focus on user experience, data management, and responsive design.

title: Namunukula Vesak Sanda – AR Vesak City
shortDescription: An augmented reality application for celebrating Vesak.
fullDescription: Namunukula Vesak Sanda is an augmented reality application designed to enhance the celebration of Vesak. It allows users to experience interactive content and virtual elements that bring the festival to life. The application showcases my skills in developing immersive AR experiences with a focus on cultural significance and user engagement.

title: Advanced Treasury Management System
shortDescription: A web application for treasury and financial management.
fullDescription: The Advanced Treasury Management System is a comprehensive web application designed to streamline treasury and financial operations. It provides users with tools to manage cash flow, track transactions, and generate reports, ensuring efficient financial oversight.

title: AI-Powered Examination System
shortDescription: An online examination and quiz platform for practical applications.
fullDescription: The AI-Powered Examination System is an innovative online platform designed to facilitate examinations and quizzes for practical applications. It leverages artificial intelligence to provide adaptive testing, instant feedback, and performance analytics, enhancing the assessment experience for both students and educators.
